create_TupleTensorQueue: create a TupleTensorQueue instance with a target device, dtype, and optional maxsize for multiprocessing
push_data_to_queue: push a tuple of tensors or data into a TupleTensorQueue with automatic device and dtype transfer
pop_from_queue: pop the next item from a TupleTensorQueue with optional blocking and timeout parameters
pop_until_latest: pop all items from a TupleTensorQueue and return only the latest message, releasing older ones
transfer_data_tensors: transfer a tuple of tensors to a specified device and dtype using the transfer_data function
